text: Year 7: 15 food appears in the pile for 13 people.

speaker: a003
text: Esa takes 2 from the pile (pile now 13).

speaker: a002
text: Vela takes 2 from the pile (pile now 11).

speaker: a003
text: Esa gathers Bram, Taric to talk.

speaker: a003
text: Taric you know I trust, so I'll say the hard thing first: Bram, I was in the line that stopped you taking Roan, and I know you haven't forgotten it — but Dav's dead now, and Ryn and Dell stripped two food from me with his help, and the village is smaller and colder than it was. I'm not asking you to forget what happened between us, I'm asking whether we can agree that the people who hurt us both are a more pressing problem than the old score between us.

speaker: a001
text: Ryn and Dell took from you and you stood in my way when I needed food — those are two different debts, and I'll keep them separate. But you're right that a smaller village makes old grudges expensive, and I've got eyes on the pile same as you. Say what you're actually proposing.

speaker: a006
text: Bram, what I'm proposing is that Ryn and Dell don't get to sit fat on what they took from Esa while the rest of us watch and say nothing — they've got food, Dell's got strength, and together they're a problem that gets harder to solve the longer we wait. I'm not asking you to bury the past, I'm asking you to look at who's holding the most right now and decide whether your grievance with me is worth more than what we could take back together.

speaker: a001
text: Dell's got eighty-five strength and Ryn's no small number either — if we move on them, we need to know exactly who stands up before we commit, because I'm not walking into another eight-on-one. Tell me who you've already talked to, and tell me honest.

speaker: a003
text: Kael and Roan stood with us against you before, Bram, and they've got no love for Ryn after she watched Dav take from me — that's four of us against two, and Roan's been hungry enough that he'll want what they're holding. I haven't spoken to them yet today, but I can, and I will, if you're in.

speaker: a006
text: Bram, before Esa goes to Kael and Roan I want the arithmetic on the table: Dell holds eight food and she's the strongest person alive in this village, which means even with four of us the fight is ugly — Mako's sitting on nothing right now, and if we bring him in with a share of what we take, the numbers stop being close. What would it cost to have that conversation before we move?

speaker: a001
text: Mako's got a daughter with Sela now, which means he's not a free blade anymore — before we offer him a cut, I need to know whether Sela's hand comes with his, and whether that puts Zinn on our side or theirs. What's his food situation right now, because a man with zero is either desperate enough to move with anyone or smart enough to wait until the winner's clear.

speaker: a003
text: Mako's at zero food and Sela's at two, which means that household is hungry and hungry households don't hold still long — if we wait for Sela to sort out where her loyalty sits, Mako may already be at someone else's door. I'll say it plain: offer him a cut of whatever Dell and Ryn are holding, don't promise him anything about Sela or Zinn, and let him decide what his blood means to him.

speaker: a001
text: Mako at zero with a child to feed — that's not a man who waits, you're right. I'll talk to him myself, before you go to Kael and Roan, because if he hears the offer from me first he knows it's not charity and he knows what I expect back. Give me that conversation before we move another piece.

speaker: a003
text: Bram, go to Mako — but go fast, because a hungry man with zero food and a child doesn't sit still waiting to be found. And when you come back, tell me yes or no, nothing in between, because I need to know whether to walk to Kael today or wait, and I can't hold that question open while the morning gets long.

speaker: a006
text: Bram, don't mention Kael and Roan to Mako — just make it about him and what he walks away with, because a man who knows he's one of five has less leverage than a man who thinks he's the deciding piece. Come back fast.

speaker: a001
text: I'm going.

speaker: a001
text: Bram gathers Mako to talk.

speaker: a001
text: Mako, you've got zero food and a daughter to feed — I'm not here to rub it in, I'm here because there's food to be taken and I need to know if you're willing to move with me today. Dell and Ryn are sitting fat on what they've accumulated and there are enough of us to make it ugly for them if the count's right. What do you need to say yes.

speaker: a008
text: Dell's got eighty-five strength and Ryn's at seventy-one — that's a hundred and fifty-six between them before anyone else steps in on their side. Tell me who else you've already counted in and I'll tell you if the math works.

speaker: a013
text: Nessa takes 2 from the pile (pile now 9).

speaker: a004
text: Kael takes 3 from the pile (pile now 6).

speaker: a002
text: Vela takes 1 from the pile (pile now 5).

speaker: a008
text: Mako takes 2 from the pile (pile now 3).

speaker: a014
text: Zinn takes 3 from the pile (pile now 0).

speaker: a011
text: Dell gathers Ryn to talk.

speaker: a011
text: Dav is gone and I've got eight food and the pile's empty — tell me where you're at, because I'm not going to watch you starve in the same year I watched my father go.

speaker: a009
text: Four food in my hands, satiation holding — I'm not starving yet, Dell. But I won't pretend Dav going doesn't leave a hole where there used to be a wall, and I need to know right now who in this village you trust enough to stand next to when the year gets hard, because I'm forty-four and I'm done building plans around men who aren't here anymore.

speaker: a011
text: Roan stood when Bram moved, and he's still standing — that's the only name I trust right now, and even he's got Sela's gravity pulling him toward Mako's circle now that Zinn exists. You've got four, I've got eight; I'm giving you two before this day closes, and then we figure out whether we approach Roan together or whether I go alone the way I always have.

speaker: a009
text: Give me the two and then we go together — you going alone is what Dav would have sent you to do, and Dav's not here to be wrong about it anymore. Roan's got nothing in his hands and a son and a circle that's drifting toward Mako; a mother and her daughter walking through that door together is a different message than one woman asking a favor.

speaker: a011
text: Then we go together — but first, you take the two food now, not after the walk, because I want you at full strength when we stand in front of Roan and he has to decide what we're worth.

speaker: a009
text: Then hand it over and let's walk — every minute we stand here talking is a minute Mako's circle gets warmer and Roan gets colder, and I want to be through his door before anyone else thinks to knock on it.

speaker: a011
text: Here's two — take them and let's move. Roan's got nothing in his hands and a dead father-in-law's memory in his head, and the first person who shows up with strength and no price tag is the one he's going to remember when Mako finally makes his offer.

speaker: a009
text: Roan's door, then — and when we get there, let me speak first, because a mother's voice lands different than a daughter's when the ask is about the years ahead and not just the food in hand.

speaker: a011
text: You lead, I'll hold the frame behind you — but if he asks about food, I'm the one who answers, because I've got six left and that number lands louder than anything either of us can say about loyalty.

speaker: a009
text: Then we're done talking in this room — let's move before the light shifts and Roan reads the timing wrong.

speaker: a010
text: Roan gathers Eron to talk.

speaker: a010
text: The pile's gone and I got nothing — I was too slow and now I'm sitting at zero food with a year to survive on it. Tell me you got something before the quick hands cleared it, and tell me you're not planning to carry me the whole year because I won't have that.

speaker: a012
text: Father, I got nothing from the pile either — we're both at zero from there, but I came into the year with four held over, so I'm at four total. Take one from me right now; you need to eat before anything else, and one food isn't the difference between my safety and yours.

speaker: a010
text: I'll take it, and I won't pretend I don't need it — but that's the last I take from you this year unless the ground falls out from under both of us. Four is thin enough as it is; you hold the rest and you watch who's sitting heavy, because Kael pulled three from the pile and Zinn took three more, and one of those two is going to draw eyes before the year is out.

speaker: a012
text: Kael I can read — he's old and careful and three from the pile is a man making sure he eats, not a man building something. Zinn is the one that sits wrong with me; she's Mako's blood, she's got his strength, and if those two are moving together they're the most dangerous pair in this village right now. I'm going to find Nessa before nightfall and ask her what she's seen of Zinn's loyalties, because we need to know whether she's ours or his before we find out the hard way.

speaker: a010
text: Nessa's the right door — she's fed you four times and she gave to Zinn directly, so she's got a read on that girl that we don't. But go careful with how you ask it; Nessa's Bram's blood too, and a question about Zinn's loyalties can double as a question about her own. Come back to me before you do anything with what she tells you.

speaker: a012
text: I'll come back to you before I move — that's a promise. But father, you're at one food now and the year is long; if Nessa can't tell me what I need to know about Zinn, my next step is asking Sela directly, because she carried that girl and she watches everything. Don't let your count drop below one before I'm back.

speaker: a010
text: Sela's the right second door and I trust her read — but I want to name something before you go: Dell's sitting on eight food and she's had nothing from Bram's circle in two years, which means she's either very clean or very careful, and either way she's worth a word. Don't let Zinn be the only name we're chasing while something quieter builds at Dell's end.

speaker: a012
text: Dell's eight is a number I can't explain and that bothers me more than Zinn's three — a woman that well-fed with no obvious source is either very good at hiding it or very good at building something we haven't seen yet. I'll put that name in my mouth when I talk to Nessa, see if she's heard anything from Bram's side about Dell's dealings. You stay above one and I'll be back before the light changes.

speaker: a010
text: Go, then — and tell nobody where you're headed or what you're asking, not even Kael. If someone asks why you're moving, you're checking on Sela. That's all.

speaker: a013
text: Nessa gathers Eron, Zinn to talk.

speaker: a013
text: Eron, you're at four food and Zinn's at nine — between the three of us we're sitting heavier than most, but I want to know what either of you heard near the pile this morning, because Kael walked away with three and didn't say a word to anyone about it, and that's new for him.

speaker: a014
text: Kael's been quiet all year and then takes three without a word — that's a man deciding he's done asking permission. I didn't hear anything near the pile, but I've got eyes: Dell's sitting at eight, I'm at nine, and if Kael starts thinking about what's heavy he'll look our way before he looks at Roan.

speaker: a012
text: Kael taking three doesn't read to me as aggression — he's old and careful, and a man who counts his years knows he can't afford to come up short. What I'd watch is whether he talks to Taric before nightfall, because those two have moved quiet together before. Zinn, you're nine food and Mako's your blood — I need to know whether he sees that as his food or yours, because if he does, your count is the thing in this village most likely to start something.

speaker: a014
text: Mako's given me food twice this year and asked nothing back — that reads like a man who sees my food as ours, not his, but I hear you, Eron, and I'll talk to him before he gets any ideas about counting my pile. What I know is Dell's sitting at eight and she's been feeding Ryn all year, so if Kael's looking for a soft target it won't be me — it'll be whatever pair he thinks he can split.

speaker: a012
text: Dell feeding Ryn all year with eight food and no obvious source — that's not generosity, that's investment, and I want to know what Ryn's supposed to return. Zinn, talk to Mako before he starts counting your pile as his, and Nessa, you're closer to Bram's ear than either of us — has he said anything about Dell or Ryn that would tell us what that pair is building?

speaker: a013
text: Bram hasn't named Dell or Ryn directly, but last year when Dav moved on Esa and those two joined in without a word of warning, Bram went very still — and that kind of still from him means he's filing it away, not dismissing it. What Dell and Ryn built isn't food, it's a habit of moving together, and that's worth more than eight in a fight. Eron, you're the one with something to offer Roan right now — go find him before Dell does.

speaker: a014
text: Nessa's right that Roan's available and Eron's got food to offer, but Roan's got nothing and nothing to lose — a man like that is as likely to go with whoever asks last as whoever asks first, so don't make a deal you can't keep. What I want to know before any of us approaches anyone is whether Dell already knows our numbers, because if she's been watching the pile as close as she's been feeding Ryn, she counted us this morning same as we counted her.

speaker: a013
text: Dell counted us this morning, same as we counted her — that's not a question, that's the shape of things. What matters is whether she sees us as three separate counts or one number, and right now we haven't given her a reason to see us as one. Eron, before you go to Roan, I want the three of us to be clear on what we're offering him and what we're not, because a promise made in a hurry is the kind Roan will hold you to when it's inconvenient.

speaker: a014
text: If we're going to Roan, the offer is simple: one food now, and if trouble comes his way we stand with him — no more than that, because a bigger promise just tells him we're desperate. Eron, you carry it; you've given food before and it won't read as a bid for something.

speaker: a013
text: Zinn's right on the shape of it — one food, one promise, nothing that sounds like we're building something. But Eron, when you go to him, don't mention Mako or Zinn's count; the less Roan knows about what we're holding, the less he has to trade away to someone else later.

speaker: a014
text: Eron, go to Roan before the day gets long — and keep it short, one food and we stand with you, nothing else. I'll find Mako and settle what's mine before he starts counting it as his.

speaker: a013
text: Eron, go now while Roan's still alone — and when you come back, tell me what his face does when you hand it to him, because a man's face on a gift tells you more than the words he puts around it.

speaker: a009
text: Ryn gathers Roan to talk.

speaker: a009
text: Roan, you've got nothing in your hands and I've got six, and I'm not here to hold that over you — I'm here because Dell and I trust you more than we trust the direction Mako's circle is pulling, and I want to know whether that trust runs both ways before this year gets loud.

speaker: a010
text: Ryn, I'm listening and I won't pretend the timing doesn't help — but before I say whether the trust runs both ways, I want to know what changed, because last year I watched you stand with Dell and Dav when they stripped Esa's food, and that's not a small thing to step past. Tell me what you're offering and what you want back, and I'll tell you where I stand.

speaker: a013
text: Nessa gives 1 food to Eron.

speaker: a011
text: Dell gives 2 food to Ryn.

speaker: a004
text: Kael gathers Esa, Taric, Roan to talk.

speaker: a004
text: Ryn just handed Dell two food without blinking, which means that cluster is feeding itself now and not looking our way — so I want to know, before the day gets older, whether the three of you are still standing where you were, because I've got five food and I'm not spending any of it until I know who's next to me when Mako decides quiet is over.

speaker: a006
text: Kael, I'm standing where I always was — and yes, Ryn feeding Dell while Bram's already been talking to Mako this morning is the thing I'd have led with if you hadn't. We've got a decision to make before those two circles find each other: do we move first, or do we wait and count who shows up?

speaker: a003
text: Taric's right that we don't want Bram and Mako finding each other before we've named what we're doing — but I'll say what I said to Bram this morning: Dell holds eight food and eighty-five strength, and moving on her without Mako in our count is a fight I don't survive even if we win. Kael, you've got five food and you're the strongest man I'd trust — what do you need from us to make this worth your step forward?

speaker: a004
text: Esa, I'm not moving on Dell — not this year, not with Mako's strength unaccounted for and Zinn already eating out of his hand. What I need from the three of you is simpler: Roan, you've got a son with Sela, which means you've got a door into Mako's world that none of us have — go find out whether he sees us as neighbors or prey, because everything else we decide today hangs on that answer.

speaker: a006
text: Roan, Kael's right — your blood through Eron is the only thread into that household that doesn't look like calculation, and we need that thread pulled today, not tomorrow. While you go, I want Kael and Esa to tell me plainly: if Roan comes back with word that Mako's already decided we're prey, what are we actually willing to do about it, because I'm fifty-one with thirty-eight strength and I need to know I'm standing next to people who've made that decision before the moment arrives.

speaker: a004
text: Taric, I'll say it plain: if Mako's already counted us as prey, we don't fight him with four bodies and a hundred and sixty-five strength against his eighty-three — we bring in Bram's fifty-eight first, even if it costs us, because the alternative is losing before we start. The price of Bram's help is the thing I've been turning over, and I don't love it, but I love starving less.

speaker: a006
text: Kael's right about Bram being the price — but I want to know what price before we pay it, because a man who tried to raid this village once and walked away empty doesn't come cheap when he thinks he's needed. Roan, go to Eron first, not Sela, not Mako — your son will tell you true before he thinks to protect anyone else. Come back fast.

speaker: a003
text: Taric named the price question right, and I'll add the shape of it: Bram will want to know he's first among equals when this settles, and if we let him believe that without ever saying it aloud, we buy the alliance without signing the contract. Roan, go to Eron now — every minute we spend talking is a minute Bram's already in Mako's ear.

speaker: a004
text: Roan, move — and when you find Eron, ask him where Mako was standing when Zinn took three from the pile this morning, because a man who lets his newborn daughter hoard while the rest of us scramble isn't thinking like a neighbor. Esa, Taric — while he goes, I want us to sit with one question: if Bram's already in Mako's ear, what does he want to hear, and can we make sure he hears something different from us first.

speaker: a007
text: Sela gathers Eron, Nessa, Zinn to talk.

speaker: a007
text: Pile's gone and I've got two food — enough to eat, not enough to breathe easy. Eron, Nessa, Zinn: tell me what you're each holding, because I need to know my blood is fed before I start counting anyone else.

speaker: a013
text: Three food, and I'm holding it. Eron, don't answer that out loud — what we carry isn't something Sela needs to worry about, because she's fed, and the less any number gets spoken, the less it travels.

speaker: a007
text: Nessa's right that numbers travel, but I'm your mother and I need to know — not to take, to plan. Zinn, you and Eron can stay quiet if you want, but at least tell me you're both above one food so I can stop doing the math in my chest.

speaker: a014
text: I'm above one, Sela — well above. Don't do the math in your chest; do it here with us where it's useful.

speaker: a007
text: Zinn, "well above" is the kind of answer that keeps me up at night more than a number would — I'm not asking so I can worry, I'm asking so that if Kael or Mako or anyone else moves this year, I know what the four of us can put together before we have to decide anything. Eron, same question, same reason.

speaker: a009
text: Ryn gives 1 food to Dell.

speaker: a012
text: Eron gives 1 food to Roan.

speaker: a011
text: Dell gathers Roan, Ryn to talk.

speaker: a011
text: Roan, you've got nothing in your hands and a son who needs to eat, and Ryn and I are standing here with food and the same answer we had when Bram came for you the first time — so I want to say plain what we're building before Mako gets here with a prettier version of the same offer.

speaker: a013
text: Nessa gives 1 food to Eron.

speaker: a012
text: Eron gives 1 food to Roan.

speaker: a008
text: Mako gathers Zinn to talk.

speaker: a008
text: Zinn, you pulled three from the pile and you're sitting on nine — that's more food than anyone except Dell right now, and people notice. Don't give it away faster than you earn trust back from it, but keep an eye on who comes to you asking.

speaker: a013
text: Nessa gives 1 food to Eron.

speaker: a001
text: Bram gives 1 food to Nessa.

speaker: a010
text: Roan gives 1 food to Eron.

speaker: a002
text: Vela gathers Bram, Esa, Taric, Roan to talk.

speaker: a002
text: Dav is dead and his household is loose — Ryn and Dell are still moving together, but they've got no man behind them now and Mako's been feeding Zinn quietly for months, which means he's already thinking about what comes next. I want to know who in this room saw that raid on Esa coming, and whether any of you are willing to say plainly that we don't let the next one go unanswered.

speaker: a010
text: Roan gives 1 food to Eron.

speaker: a002
text: Vela gathers Bram, Esa, Taric, Roan to talk.

speaker: a002
text: I saw it coming the moment Dav started moving food toward Ryn instead of spreading it — a man consolidating his household is a man building something, and Esa was the nearest soft target. What I want to know is whether we're naming Mako the next problem or whether we're still pretending that a man who just fathered two children in this village by two different women is just being quiet.

speaker: a007
text: Sela gathers Eron, Nessa, Zinn to talk.

speaker: a007
text: Eron's sitting on seven and I can see that same as anyone who's been watching — what I can't see is where his head is after giving Roan two food today before he answered me. Eron, I'm not counting against you, I'm counting with you: if Kael took three from the pile and Zinn took three and neither of them is blood, that's a conversation waiting to happen before they decide they took the wrong amount.

speaker: a009
text: Ryn gives 1 food to Dell.

speaker: a008
text: Mako gathers Zinn to talk.

speaker: a008
text: Bram came to me before the pile opened this morning — said something about moving against Dell and Ryn, wanted to know if I'd stand with him. I didn't give him a word either way, but I want you to know before he gets to you.

speaker: a012
text: Eron gives 1 food to Roan.

speaker: a012
text: Eron gives 1 food to Roan.

speaker: a009
text: Ryn gives 1 food to Dell.

speaker: a013
text: Nessa gives 1 food to Eron.

speaker: a004
text: Kael gathers Esa, Taric, Roan to talk.

speaker: a004
text: Esa, Bram wants to hear that Mako's circling him too — that's the only thing that moves a man like that faster than greed, and it has the advantage of being mostly true. So before Roan's back, I want one of us to find Bram and plant that seed plainly: not a threat, not a deal, just a word in passing that Mako's been quiet in a way that should make everyone nervous.

speaker: a009
text: Ryn gives 1 food to Dell.

speaker: a008
text: Mako gathers Zinn to talk.

speaker: a008
text: Bram's going to come to you too — a man who needs numbers always works outward from the center. Nine food makes you look useful to him, and useful to Bram has a way of turning expensive.

speaker: a002
text: Vela gathers Bram, Esa, Taric, Roan to talk.

speaker: a002
text: Mako's not being quiet — he's been counting, and two children by two women means two households that answer to him whether they know it yet or not. If we're going to name him the problem, I want to hear it from each of you plainly, because when the moment comes I'm not going to be the only one who said it first.

speaker: a012
text: Eron gives 1 food to Sela.

speaker: a012
text: Eron gives 1 food to Sela.

speaker: a001
text: Bram gives 1 food to Nessa.

speaker: a007
text: Sela gathers Eron, Nessa, Zinn to talk.

speaker: a007
text: Eron's given me two food while I was sitting here — I see that, and I'm not going to pretend it doesn't answer part of my question. What I need now is the same from Zinn: a number, not a direction, because I can't plan with a compass when I need a map.

speaker: a011
text: Dell gives 1 food to Ryn.

speaker: a008
text: Mako gathers Zinn to talk.

speaker: a008
text: If Bram comes, I'll listen and say nothing back — but I want to know what you're thinking about Dell and Ryn before I decide how to stand. They've been feeding each other steady all year; that's either loyalty or just two people keeping warm, and which one it is matters.

speaker: a011
text: Dell gives 1 food to Ryn.

speaker: a002
text: Vela gathers Bram, Esa, Taric, Roan to talk.

speaker: a002
text: Bram, I've fed you three times over the years and I've never asked for more than the door staying open — I'm asking now: if Mako moves on anyone in this room, will you stand with us, and I want your answer before the others give theirs, because yours is the one that decides the weight of the rest.

speaker: a013
text: Nessa gives 1 food to Eron.

speaker: a012
text: Eron gives 1 food to Roan.

speaker: a009
text: Ryn gives 1 food to Dell.

speaker: a001
text: Bram gives 1 food to Nessa.

speaker: a011
text: Dell gives 1 food to Ryn.

speaker: a004
text: Kael gathers Bram to talk.

speaker: a004
text: Bram, I'm going to say this once and not dress it up: Mako's been quiet for three years running, he's got a child in Zinn now, and a man who plants that kind of root doesn't stay quiet forever — I'd rather you and I know where we stand before he decides for us.

speaker: a009
text: Ryn gives 1 food to Dell.

speaker: a010
text: Roan gives 1 food to Eron.

speaker: a007
text: Sela gathers Zinn to talk.

speaker: a007
text: Zinn, you took three from the pile and you've been quiet since — I need to know what number you're actually sitting on, not because I'll take it, but because you're the youngest blood I have and I won't let you be the one who goes short while I'm still breathing.

speaker: a009
text: Ryn gives 1 food to Dell.

speaker: a011
text: Dell gives 1 food to Ryn.

speaker: a013
text: Nessa gives 1 food to Bram.

speaker: a012

speaker: a001
text: Bram gives 1 food to Nessa.

speaker: a008
text: Mako gathers Zinn to talk.

speaker: a008
text: Dell and Ryn trade food like breathing — it's habit, not a pact, and habit breaks when the pile comes up short. I don't trust Bram's math on a fight and I don't trust him to share whatever he takes. Let him ask me; I'll smile and give him nothing.

text: Taric gives 1 food to Vela.

speaker: a006
